name: paperclip
description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
one_liner: An open-source dashboard where you hire a team of AI agents (a CEO, engineers, marketers) to chase a business goal, and watch them work like a virtual company org chart.
buyer: A solo founder or small agency owner running several AI-driven side projects who wants one dashboard instead of juggling a dozen separate agent scripts.
business_use_cases: A solo founder assigns 'grow my newsletter to 10k subscribers' and lets an agent team draft, post, and report back weekly.
An AI-ops agency resells a hosted instance as the client-facing dashboard showing what their virtual AI staff did each day.
A bootstrapped SaaS founder runs a virtual 'CTO + 2 engineers' crew to triage and merge low-risk pull requests overnight.

money_ideas.idea: Hosted version with managed agent credentials and billing per active agent-seat.
Done-for-you onboarding service that builds a client's first AI org chart and budget guardrails.

steal_this: Self-host it this weekend, wire in one real API key, and sell 'AI ops manager for a day' as a $500 setup service to a local small business.
